# Cocos 2.4.15 integration fixture

Hand-written, not generated by Cocos Creator: `index.html` and `main.js` build the `InspectorTest` scene in code (Canvas, Main Camera, Panel with an `InspectorFixture` component, Label, Sprite, Button).

- Engine: not included; see Engine below.
- Scope: every 2.x tool except `cocos_analyze_batches`. Creator 3.x fixtures come from `fixture/build.sh`.
- Do not replace `cocos2d-js-min.js` with a different engine version without updating the test.

## Engine

`cocos2d-js-min.js` is git-ignored and never committed. Point `COCOS_2X_ENGINE` at the file, or install Creator 2.4.15 (the test falls back to `C:/ProgramData/cocos/editors/Creator/2.4.15/resources/engine/bin/.cache/web-mobile/cocos2d-js-min.js`). Without it the 2.x integration test is reported as skipped with that instruction.
